speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. To determine the cause of your acute diarrhea, please describe your symptoms and how long you have been feeling ill. Do you have a fever, blood in your stool, or recent travel history?

speaker: Patient
text: 58-year-old female. The patient has been treated for community-acquired pneumonia with levofloxacin on the medical floor. She reports developing watery diarrhea with at least 9 episodes within the last two days, accompanied by lower abdominal discomfort and cramping.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Levofloxacin-associated *Clostridioides difficile* infection.

I have identified the likely cause based on your recent use of levofloxacin for pneumonia and the onset of frequent watery diarrhea with cramping. I am requesting your stool sample results to confirm the presence of *C. difficile* toxins before we initiate targeted treatment. REQUEST TEST: Stool_C_difficile_toxin_assay.
